# Configuration file for the Sphinx documentation builder.

Upstream: https://github.com/rapidsai/docs
Commit: f5dac7bbc4942554dd47effe23df77a32b209780
License: Apache-2.0 (SPDX headers retained in both files)

custom.css: assets/css/custom.css
custom.js: assets/js/custom.js

The upstream styles are loaded before ../../cuml-spark.css, which supplies
cuML Spark's emerald accents.

Local JavaScript adaptation: skip updating the shared theme-switch tooltip when
#theme-switch is absent. Native PyData pages use .theme-switch-button instead.
